baseline_models.focus_anchor: The nominal predicate سَلَامٌ is carried by هِيَ to the حَتَّى boundary formed by مَطْلَعِ الْفَجْرِ.
baseline_models.mechanism: Soundness governs the whole interval, while the rising-place/time and the breaking of dawn make its far edge an event of opening. The clause therefore presents protected wholeness maintained right up to a transition, not merely a calm mood associated with a clock time.

activation_trace.role: Freedom from harm and defect supplies the sound condition predicated of the entire interval.
A luminary's act, time, or place of rising makes the endpoint a threshold-event.
Dawn breaking from night supplies the ordinary terminal event of the protected interval.
Wide splitting and outflow sharpen dawn from a time label into an opening process.

changed_reading.before: The clause offers a greeting or says generically that there is peace until dawn.
changed_reading.after: The clause predicates protected wholeness of the whole interval and makes dawn's splitting emergence, rather than a clock label alone, its boundary.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The root branches behind سَلَامٌ, مَطْلَعِ, and الْفَجْرِ can align as transfer, access, and opening under the directional force of حَتَّى.
baseline_models.mechanism: A consignment is carried through a bounded corridor toward an access-point where an opening releases what has been conveyed. This is form-distant from the ordinary noun sense of سَلَامٌ, but all three functional stages remain attached to focus words.

activation_trace.role: Handing over, consigning, and letting go supply the transfer that moves through the interval.
An ascent or access-point supplies the approached terminal gateway.
Splitting with outflow supplies the opening and release at the gateway.

changed_reading.before: Peace is a static state that simply lasts until dawn.
changed_reading.after: The interval can also be carried as an orderly handover whose route reaches an access-point and opens out at dawn.

context_deltas.mechanism: Delivery into darkness plus measure and planning gives the focus-only handover a reason for both its protection and its limit. سَلَامٌ becomes the intact execution phase of a measured conveyance, and dawn is its scheduled completion-opening.

activation_trace.role: Consignment and handover supply the focus-side transfer being executed.
Freedom from damage supplies the requirement that the transfer remain intact.
The act or time of rising supplies the delivery's explicit completion boundary.
An opening with outflow supplies the terminal release of what was conveyed.
Bringing something down and delivering it supplies the incoming conveyance.
Night and its darkness supply the bounded medium through which the conveyance passes.
A measure that brings a thing to its limit supplies exact scope and duration.
Deliberate planning and apportionment supply design rather than accidental timing.

structural_cues: 97:1 locates the delivered object inside a named night, while 97:5 carries a nominal state to an explicit حَتَّى boundary.
The packet sequence moves from descent, night, and measure to soundness, rising, and rupture.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies delivery, darkness, measured limit, planning, protected handover, and dawn-opening; I infer a protected transit with a scheduled completion. A live alternative is simple descent during a measured night followed by ordinary temporal peace.

changed_reading.before: The focus-only handover corridor is possible but has no stated reason for its protected timing.
changed_reading.after: The preceding measured delivery makes peace the protected execution phase of a planned transfer that reaches completion when dawn opens.

context_deltas.mechanism: The split inventory joins explicit knowing with whiteness, purity, and shine; those cues meet the focus branches of disclosure and dawn-breaking. The temporal crossing can therefore also stage a passage from withheld knowledge into sound, luminous apprehension.

activation_trace.role: Inner and outer soundness supplies an error-free or undamaged mode of apprehension.
Looking into and disclosing a matter supplies the epistemic emergence at the boundary.
Morning light breaking from night materializes the transition from occlusion to clarity.
Knowledge and awareness directly supply the question's epistemic axis.
Pearl-like whiteness, purity, and shine give the split root cue a visible clarity that dawn can enact.

structural_cues: The repeated interrogative in 97:2 withholds knowledge before the focus supplies an image of emergence.
مَطْلَع can name act, time, or place, so the temporal endpoint can simultaneously function as disclosure.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an explicit knowledge branch, a split-root radiance branch, disclosure, soundness, and daybreak; I infer an epistemic transition from concealment to clarity. The live alternative is that the question only magnifies the night's status and dawn remains strictly temporal.

changed_reading.before: Dawn is only the chronological endpoint of a safe night.
changed_reading.after: Dawn also becomes the horizon at which withheld significance appears, making peace a sound passage into disclosed clarity.

context_deltas.mechanism: Qualitative excellence confronts a thousand counted months, while the thousand-root also supplies gathering and composition. Reconciliation integrates that multiplicity into one sound interval; fullness at the brim and overflowing generosity then recast dawn as the release of concentrated good.

activation_trace.role: Reconciliation and peaceful accord supply the integration of otherwise separate temporal units.
Fullness to the brim supplies the intensive saturation reached at the boundary.
Overflowing generosity supplies the outward release of the interval's concentrated good.
Excellence, rectitude, and selection supply qualitative superiority over mere extension.
A thousand as an aggregation of hundreds supplies the large calendrical multiplicity.
Joining one thing to another supplies the compositional compression of that multiplicity.
The lunar month supplies the repeated calendrical units being gathered.

structural_cues: 97:3 directly juxtaposes qualitative خير with the quantity ألف شهر.
One night is compared with many months immediately before one nominal state is extended to dawn.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies excellence, numerical aggregation, composition, calendrical units, reconciliation, fullness, and generosity; I infer that comparative value can operate as intensive compression. The live alternative is a straightforward statement of superior reward or duration with no compositional mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Until dawn measures a short duration during which peace is present.
changed_reading.after: The short interval becomes concentrated plenitude: it reconciles many temporal units into one excellent whole, fills to dawn, and breaks outward as good.

context_deltas.mechanism: Descending agents, authorization, sovereignty, total scope, and commands turn the handover model into an ordered dispatch. Peace is the operation's integrity: distinct agents convey commissions without collision or breach, while dawn marks the end of the authorized operating window.

activation_trace.role: Handing over and consigning supply the operational transfer performed through the night.
Peaceful dealing and reconciliation supply coordination without conflict among the dispatching agents.
The act or time of a luminary's rising supplies the operating window's cutoff.
Splitting and outflow supply the final release from the bounded dispatch phase.
Causing something to descend and arrive supplies the dispatch's conveyance.
The angel branch identifies one class of descending agents in the packet.
Life-bearing spirit supplies the coordinated second subject of the descent.
Permission and licensing supply explicit authorization for the operation.
Lordship, ownership, and sovereignty supply the authorizing command source.
Encompassment and totality supply the dispatch's comprehensive scope.
Command and obligation supply the commissions being executed.

structural_cues: The active imperfect descent with coordinated subjects in 97:4 is followed by the nominal result-state سَلَامٌ هِيَ in 97:5.
The authorization phrase and distributive كل أمر precede the explicit حَتَّى cutoff.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies descent, named agents, permission, sovereignty, totality, command, transfer, and reconciliation; I infer a coordinated execution chain whose success-condition is سلام. A live alternative is an unstructured sacred presence in which سلام remains atmosphere rather than operational integrity.

changed_reading.before: Peace is the atmosphere accompanying descent until dawn.
changed_reading.after: Peace is also the integrity of an authorized all-scope dispatch: commissions are conveyed in coordination throughout a bounded night shift.

context_deltas.mechanism: Returning a right to its owner, repairing and completing, encompassing the whole, and addressing each affair form a restorative chain. On this branch path, peace is not merely lack of conflict but the settlement of every matter into a sound relation before dawn discloses the completed ordering.

activation_trace.role: Freedom from defect supplies the condition achieved when outstanding matters are repaired.
Reconciliation supplies the restored relation produced by settlement.
Disclosure of a matter supplies the boundary at which completed ordering becomes visible.
Opening and outflow supply the release that follows settlement.
Returning a right to its owner supplies the restorative act.
Repair, nurture, and completion supply the process that brings matters into sound condition.
Wholeness and encompassment supply the claim that no affair remains outside the settlement.
Affair and condition supply the individual matters being restored.

structural_cues: The distributive كل modifies أمر immediately before the focus declares one encompassing nominal state.
The focus endpoint follows the all-affairs phrase, allowing dawn to function as disclosure of completion.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies return of right, repair and completion, totality, affairs, soundness, and reconciliation; I infer a shared restorative direction toward settled order. A live alternative is the stronger authorized-dispatch model, where these roots describe agency and scope without implying rectification.

changed_reading.before: Peace means absence of disturbance during the night.
changed_reading.after: Peace can name the positive restoration of every affair to sound relation, maintained until dawn reveals and releases the completed order.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the edge branch in which an injured person is called sound and pairs it with a descending affliction; the ayah itself names no wound. It remains anchored in سَلَامٌ and the explicit until-dawn delay, so downstream prose should present it only as a performative or hopeful naming analogy, not as a claim that the verse denotes injury.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: سَلَامٌ can be tested as a name spoken ahead of realized safety, while حَتَّى مَطْلَعِ الْفَجْرِ postpones visible confirmation.

activation_trace.role: Calling the snakebitten person sound either hopefully or in surrender supplies proleptic naming under unresolved harm.
Consigning or yielding an affair supplies the posture that can accompany such hopeful naming.
Appearance upon people supplies the later manifestation by which the naming is tested.
Dawn breaking from night supplies the delayed moment of visible relief.
A severity that descends supplies the contextual pressure under which safety could be named before it is seen.

changed_reading.before: سَلَامٌ reports an already achieved fact of safety.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, سَلَامٌ can also act as hopeful performative speech that holds a threatened interval under the name of safety until relief appears.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The reading is form-distant because it hears the ladder/means branch behind the ordinary noun سَلَامٌ. It remains worth carrying because ladder, ascent/access, and rising dawn form a complete focus-only spatial mechanism; downstream prose should mark it as root-play or vertical analogy, not substitute ladder for peace in translation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The three focus roots alone can align as a means of ascent, an access-point, and the rising of dawn.

activation_trace.role: A ladder or means supplies the traversable route encoded behind the opening noun.
Ascent and access-point supply the route's direction and upper threshold.
Dawn rising out of night supplies the destination reached by the vertical passage.

changed_reading.before: The ayah describes a state extending horizontally through time.
changed_reading.after: As contained root-play, the same interval becomes a vertical means of passage ascending toward dawn's access-point.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This cross-domain reading is surprising because it treats descent, breeze, nourishment, plant emergence, and outflow as an overnight growth system, and it uses the non-dominant ر ب ب to ر ب و mapping. It remains anchored in direct focus branches for soundness, plant emergence, and splitting outflow; downstream prose should label it a material analogy rather than a lexical or doctrinal identification.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: سَلَامٌ supplies a sound condition, مَطْلَع supplies plant emergence, and الْفَجْر supplies an opening outflow at daybreak.

activation_trace.role: Soundness and freedom from defect supply the healthy condition of the overnight medium.
The emergence of palm spadix and plants supplies germination at the threshold.
Wide splitting and water outflow supply the opening through which growth appears.
Descent and settling supply an input arriving into the overnight system.
Wind and breeze supply the moving breath of the material analogy.
The split target's nourishment and growth branch supplies development toward emergence.
Growth and blessing supply the productive result of the system.

changed_reading.before: Peace is an immaterial atmosphere that lasts until sunrise.
changed_reading.after: As a contained ecological analogy, the night is a sound growing medium receiving descent and breath until shoots and waters split outward at dawn.

strongest_changes: The focus-only state of soundness becomes a measured, protected handover once descent, night, and apportionment are activated.
The descent of agents by permission and across every command makes peace readable as the integrity of an authorized dispatch.
The knowledge split-root turns dawn from a temporal endpoint into an enacted disclosure from occlusion to clarity.
summary.what_was_special: The focus roots repeatedly couple intactness with a threshold that rises, discloses, splits, and releases; context then supplies measure, agency, authorization, totality, and even split-root radiance or growth without forcing those readings into one synthesis.
remaining_uncertainties: مَطْلَع can foreground act, time, or place, and the packet does not force one of these profiles.
The handover, restorative, vertical, performative, and ecological models depend on branch-level analogy rather than the ordinary surface sense of سَلَامٌ.
The administrative direction in the dispatch model and the compression direction in the plenitude model are reader-supplied arrows, not explicit causal statements in the packet.
